item.tib: drag sngags gsang ba'i spu gri las gtor zlog byad ma'i dpung bshigs
item.coloph: ces kyi gtor zlog 'di ni nyag shod a dza rang gi ru lag tshe dbang gnas chen a bswe brag dkar nas zab gter rin po che'i (che) spyan drangs shing / slar mchog sprul nyi ma dang g.yung drung bstan 'dzin sogs kyis bskul ngor/ gsang sngags gling pas lo tsha'i brda' ris bod yig tu phab pa'o//
